name: Hiding In The Dark Redux
summary:
Hiding In The Dark Redux is a horror survival experience where fear controls every step you take. Set in a dark, abandoned town, the game challenges you to survive while being hunted by two unique and relentless monsters. The town may look empty, but danger is always nearby, watching and waiting for a mistake.
